message: ...When I came to, everything was already over.
Out of nowhere, my attacks stopped landing on Momiji, and while I was panicking, everything suddenly went pitch-black.
By the time I realized what had happened, I was lying on a bed in the stadium's infirmary.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sigh... I totally missed Momimomi's Sword Dance Ceremony.」
And I really wanted to see what kind of face she'd make while dancing, too.
Kei-chan was with me until just a moment ago, but I told her I could make it back to the dorm on my own and parted ways with her.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Man, I really lost...」
Momiji won the tournament and became the Toujinegi.
Naturally, I wasn't able to become the Toujinegi.

name: Asahi
message: 「Setsugekka-san.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, Asahi-chan. What's up？」
As I approached the school gate, Asahi-chan came walking up to me.

name: Asahi
message: 「What a shame about the match.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whew, Momimomi was seriously strong. I thought I got pretty close, though.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Do you know why your attacks stopped hitting Momiji-san toward the end？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Nope, no idea. Do you know, Asahi-chan？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, I have a good idea.」

name: Asahi
message: 「In all likelihood, Momiji-san has attained the state of Shohou Muga that Iori-sensei was trying to teach.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, that thing she was doing all that seated meditation for.」
According to Asahi-chan, entering that state is apparently like having Shingan no Kiwamete activated at all times.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whaaat?! That's way too overpowered! There's no way anyone could beat that!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, I think so too.」

name: Asahi
message: 「However, that is the very essence of the swordswoman known as Suzakuin Momiji, and it is Momiji-san's true strength.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Denying the truth won't get us anywhere.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-Well, I guess you're right, but...」

name: Asahi
message: 「She may have taken the title of Toujinegi this year, but next year, I will definitely wrest it away from Momiji-san.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Let's both give it our all together, Setsugekka-san.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, yeah... You're right!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Well then, please excuse me. I'm glad to see you're looking better than I expected.」
With that, Asahi left.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haa... next year, huh.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ooh, you're back, you're back!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Secchan! Are you okay!？」
The moment she spotted my face, Ririmu lunged at me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, what's gotten into you, Ririmu-chan！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I went to the infirmary, but you weren't waking up, Secchan, so I was worried.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But I'm glad you look fine now.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm hardly fine~, I lost, you know.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「There, there, such a good girl~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yawn... hey, stop treating me like a kid!」
I swatted away Ririmu's hand as she patted my head.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Secchan, that was a great match.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Both you and Momitch were really strong. I seriously thought, 'I'm no match for them at all right now.'」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That's not true, you're strong too, Ririmu-chan.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No, seriously, for real, you two were insane！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Watching that match made me think I'm gonna have to work super hard just to catch up.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So hey, let's do some special training together this summer break! Like, go off into the mountains or something!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahaha, you don't seem like the mountain type at all, Ririmu-chan. You're secretly a celebrity, after all.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh yeah, my family has our own RV, so we'd use that.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It's got a shower and a toilet, so the mountains will be a breeze!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, this is exactly why rich kids are the way they are.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No way, the Kazamines are plenty rich too, right?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, now that you mention it, that's true.」
We both laughed together.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Alright, I'm heading back to my room now~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, see you tomorrow!」
I watch Ririmu-chan as she heads back to the dormitory.
I'm sure Asahi-chan, and Ririmu-chan too,
were both worried about me and waiting for me.

name: Iori
message: 「...Oh, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, Sensei.」
When I arrived at my room in the dormitory, Muragaki-sensei was standing there.

name: Iori
message: 「Are you feeling alright？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahー, I'm still a bit sore all over, actually~」
Even though I was protected by my Barrier Jacket, the damage still lingered, as expected.

name: Iori
message: 「I see. Shall we go to the infirmary together？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No, no, I literally just got back. You're such a worrywart, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「It's only natural. You are my precious student, Setsugekka.」
A precious student, huh....

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, that was a very good match.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahー... but I lost, after all.」

name: Iori
message: 「That's true...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, but the one who won is also your student, Sensei. I guess you could call that a proud achievement, right!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「As expected of Muragaki-sensei, I respect you!」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka......」
Sensei turns a face toward me that looks worried, troubled, and yet uneasy.
Seeing him look at me like that makes me feel awkward.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, what are you planning to do tomorrow？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh, am I allowed to take it off？ If so, I will!」

name: Iori
message: 「No, normal students have regular classes, and I'd like you to attend if you're able to... but you don't have to push yourself.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It's fine, I'll be there.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see. That's good.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Alright then, with that settled~！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, good night.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haaah...」
After having all sorts of people worry about me, I finally made it back to my room.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Man, winning is tough, but losing is tough too~」
When people show me this much concern from every direction, I end up having to be extra careful around them in return.
Still, I finally got to be alone.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Haaah, I really wanted to win.」
Now that I'm alone, it finally sinks in.
I couldn't win the Martial Festival.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I think I made it pretty far, though...」
At first I went berserk and was totally hopeless, though.
Thanks to Muragaki-sensei, I made it into the Martial Festival main tournament.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, being a first-year and all, just making it to the main tournament is already enough of a miracle, y'know...」
When I beat Victoria-senpai, who was the Toujinegi, even I couldn't believe it.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sono-chan-senpai even told me I was cool, and not to lose...！」
And then in the finals, facing off against Momiji.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「All I had left to do was beat Momimomi...！」
I couldn't become the Toujinegi.
I couldn't keep my promise to Kei-chan.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Even though Kei-chan told me... that I'm the strongest swordsman of the Kazamine...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Even though... she actually made that promise with me, I...」
If I could've become the Toujinegi, staying right here at the academy.
Taking classes at this academy together with everyone in Takamura Class in the second semester too. With Kei―chan there too, all of us―

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh, snff... I really wanted to keep this life going...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hic... With Muragaki-sensei, Asahi-chan, Ririmu-chan, Kei-chan, and Momimomi...！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I wanted to spend time together with everyone...！」
Tears spill over, endlessly.
Having a blast together through autumn and winter too. Moving up to the second year at the academy together.
Doing special training for the Martial Festival like this again.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hff, ugh... waaaah...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I wanted to... spend the best time... with you...！！」
Her voice failed her after that.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hiiiuh, uwaaaaaaaa...nn...！！」
It wasn't anyone's fault.
It was just that I wasn't strong enough.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Fuaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa...！！」
I was ashamed and pathetic for having lost.
I buried my face in my futon and kept crying—
